summary: Autonomous AI agents at scale, sub-2nm chips, and the NISQ quantum threshold.
bodyHtml:
⚠ This horizon blends high-confidence milestones with best-estimate forecasts. Timelines may compress or slip by 12–24 months.

Milestones

2028–2029
Autonomous AI Agents Deployed at Enterprise Scale
AI agents that can plan, execute, and manage multi-step workflows without human intervention become production systems at Fortune 500 companies. Software valuations reprice around agent seat metrics, not user seats.
MSFTNOWCRMPLTR
Leader: MSFT · 90% vs PLTR 70% · +1 more
2028–2029
TSMC 1nm (A10) Risk Production
First wafers at the angstrom-era node. Requires new transistor architectures (CFET, 2D materials). Intel 14A competing on equal footing for the first time since 2019.
TSMINTCASML
Leader: ASML · 95% vs TSM 85% · INTC 70% · +1 more
2029
Humanoid Robots in Commercial Deployment
First humanoid robots deployed in warehouses, manufacturing, and elder care at meaningful scale. Tesla Optimus, Figure, 1X, Apptronik competing. Labour economics begin to shift in early adopter verticals.
TSLAISRGHON
Leader: ISRG · 95% no rivals identified
2029–2030
Quantum Computing Crosses 10,000 Physical Qubits
IBM, Google, and IonQ projected to cross 10,000 physical qubit milestones. Error correction improving but fault-tolerant logical qubits still 3–5 years away from this point.
IONQQBTSRGTI
Leader: IONQ · 95%
2030
Level 4 Autonomous Vehicles in Major Cities
Robotaxi networks operating without safety drivers in 50+ cities globally. Waymo, Tesla FSD, Baidu Apollo leading. Insurance, liability, and regulation as growth constraints.
TSLAGOOGL
Leader: GOOGL · 95% no rivals identified

Next: 2030: 2040 →
